scientific_limitations: For a general polytope the vertex-cone coefficient is exact for sufficiently small positive radii, not necessarily all radii.
The exact global polygon bound requires genuine convex vertices and fixed number of sides.
Near-equality controls interior angles, not side lengths or closeness to a regular polygon.
Literature novelty remains provisional owing to possible unlocated classical mathematical-morphology equivalences.
title: Sharp disk-opening loss for convex polygons and a vertex-cone formula for polytopes
